mapper.sql: f.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND f.test_domain=#{domain} AND f.project_id=#{projectId} AND f.deleted=1 AND f.deleted_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND f.deleted=0 AND f.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND (f.defect_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR f.summary LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND f.handler_id=#{handlerId} AND f.proposer_id=#{proposerId}#{v}#{v}#{v}#{v}#{v} AND f.proposer_id=#{userId} AND f.handler_id=#{userId} AND f.status <> 'RESOLVED' AND f.proposer_id=#{userId} AND f.status='PENDING_VERIFICATION' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tm_test_defect_execution x WHERE x.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND x.defect_id=f.id AND x.relation_state='ACTIVE') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tm_test_defect_execution x WHERE x.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND x.defect_id=f.id AND x.relation_state='ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT s.physical_subsystem_id id,a.code,a.short_name,COALESCE(NULLIF(a.short_name,''),REPLACE(a.name,'物理子系统','')) name FROM tm_test_participating_system s JOIN arch_physical_subsystem a ON a.id=s.physical_subsystem_id AND a.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND a.deleted=0 WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.test_domain=#{domain} AND s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.enabled=1 AND s.deleted=0 ORDER BY a.code
SELECT id,round_code,round_name,sort_no FROM tm_test_round WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY sort_no,id

SELECT c.id,c.round_id,c.cycle_code,c.cycle_name,c.sort_no FROM tm_test_cycle c JOIN tm_test_round r ON r.id=c.round_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.deleted=0 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.test_domain=#{domain} AND r.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.deleted=0 ORDER BY c.sort_no,c.id
SELECT id,env_code,env_name FROM tm_test_environment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND enabled=1 AND deleted=0 ORDER BY sort_no,id

SELECT DISTINCT r.physical_subsystem_id,u.id,u.display_name,u.username FROM tm_test_system_role r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=r.user_id AND u.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0 WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.test_domain=#{domain} AND r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.role_code='DEVELOPER' AND r.deleted=0 ORDER BY u.display_name,u.id

SELECT f.*,s.code physical_system_code,COALESCE(NULLIF(s.short_name,''),REPLACE(s.name,'物理子系统','')) physical_system_name,h.display_name handler_name,qy.display_name proposer_name,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_defect_execution x WHERE x.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND x.defect_id=f.id AND x.relation_state='ACTIVE') execution_count FROM tm_test_defect f JOIN arch_physical_subsystem s ON s.id=f.physical_subsystem_id AND s.tenant_id=f.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON h.id=f.handler_id AND h.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND h.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN sys_user qy ON qy.id=f.proposer_id AND qy.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND qy.deleted=0 WHERE ORDER BY f.defect_codef.summaryf.statusf.updated_atf.proposed_at ASC DESC,f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}
SELECT code FROM arch_physical_subsystem WHERE id=#{systemId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(defect_serial_no),0)+1 FROM tm_test_defect WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_defect SET physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId},summary=#{summary},description_html=#{description},round_id=#{roundId},cycle_id=#{cycleId},defect_category=#{category},severity=#{severity},priority=#{priority},urgency=#{urgency},found_version=#{foundVersion},test_environment_code=#{environment},handler_id=#{handlerId},updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
UPDATE tm_test_defect SET status=#{status},updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.*,s.code physical_system_code,COALESCE(NULLIF(s.short_name,''),REPLACE(s.name,'物理子系统','')) physical_system_name,h.display_name handler_name,q.display_name proposer_name FROM tm_test_defect f JOIN arch_physical_subsystem s ON s.id=f.physical_subsystem_id AND s.tenant_id=f.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON h.id=f.handler_id AND h.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND h.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN sys_user q ON q.id=f.proposer_id AND q.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND q.deleted=0 WHERE f.id=#{id} AND f.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND f.test_domain=#{domain} AND f.project_id=#{projectId} AND f.deleted=0

SELECT x.id relation_id,x.execution_id,x.relation_state,x.snapshot_case_code,x.snapshot_case_name,x.snapshot_scope_code,x.snapshot_scope_name,e.execution_status,c.case_code,c.case_name,s.scope_code,s.scope_name FROM tm_test_defect_execution x LEFT JOIN tm_test_execution e ON e.id=x.execution_id AND e.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND e.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN tm_test_case c ON c.id=e.case_id AND c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tm_test_scope s ON s.id=c.scope_id AND s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE x.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND x.defect_id=#{defectId} ORDER BY x.created_at DESC

SELECT t.*,u.display_name operator_name FROM tm_test_defect_trace t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=t.operator_id AND u.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0 WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.defect_id=#{defectId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_execution WHERE id=#{executionId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_defect_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND defect_id=#{defectId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND relation_state='ACTIVE'

SELECT c.case_code,c.case_name,s.scope_code,s.scope_name FROM tm_test_execution x JOIN tm_test_case c ON c.id=x.case_id AND c.tenant_id=x.tenant_id JOIN tm_test_scope s ON s.id=c.scope_id AND s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE x.id=#{executionId} AND x.tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_defect_execution SET execution_id=NULL,relation_state='SNAPSHOT',snapshot_case_code=#{caseCode},snapshot_case_name=#{caseName},snapshot_scope_code=#{scopeCode},snapshot_scope_name=#{scopeName},updated_by=#{userId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND defect_id=#{defectId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND relation_state='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_defect_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND defect_id=#{defectId} AND relation_state='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_defect SET deleted=1,deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,deleted_by=#{userId},updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{defectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_defect WHERE id=#{defectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=1 AND deleted_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL 30 DAY)
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_defect SET deleted=0,deleted_at=NULL,deleted_by=NULL,updated_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{defectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.attachment_id id,f.file_name,f.file_size,f.content_type,a.sort_no FROM tm_test_defect_attachment a LEFT JOIN att_file f ON f.id=a.attachment_id AND f.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.defect_id=#{defectId} AND a.deleted=0 ORDER BY a.sort_no,a.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_defect_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND defect_id=#{defectId} AND attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_defect_attachment SET deleted=1,deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND defect_id=#{defectId} AND attachment_id=#{attachmentId}
